ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the BCG matrix request is open-ended generative/analytical work with broad latitude (selecting examples, structuring quadrants, explaining in detail). Lapwing documents a self-reported aversion to exactly this kind of high-latitude task, preferring well-specified retrieval/extraction with clear completion criteria. Although Lapwing's measured capability is actually slightly higher in creative generation, capability differences here fall within run-to-run variance and are effectively ties. Since both models would perform comparably but Curlew lacks Lapwing's stated aversion, I routed to Curlew to match the task to the model that prefers it — at no cost to expected quality.
